svg.title: CSS Earth — Close Focus with Earth tilt and no grid lines
svg.desc: The accepted perspective sphere with all meridian and latitude dots removed, leaving only its existing three-dimensional noise field.
svg.metadata: Exactly 9770 unchanged spherical noise dots retained; all 1800 grid dots removed without redistribution; perspective distance 2.35, pitch 35 degrees, visible axial tilt 23.44 degrees; unchanged 10.5-unit radius and #aaa fill; no lines, shading, strokes, gradients, filters, masks, or effects.
